limits: An isolated browser context is used; no user browser session is accessed.

Non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS requests are blocked. Structured events omit request headers and bodies; raw traces, DOM, video and screenshots may retain network/page data and require separate review before sharing.

HTTP document redirects are blocked before following, including same-origin redirects; that support is unqualified. Top-level documents use one guarded fetch without redirect following, then the actual response is fulfilled into the browser.
This is an execution record, not a product-quality or general-performance benchmark.

The optional activation guard checks actual native controls, labels and declared state before activation. It is a cooperative observation boundary, not isolation from arbitrary page scripts or full accessible-name certification. Guarded keys are Tab/Shift+Tab and unmodified Enter/Space only.
